# Measurable AI

> Consumer insights for emerging markets based on e-receipt data, including food delivery, ride-hailing, and e-commerce.

Report landing pages contain public summaries and request forms. Gated report requests require user details and explicit user approval before submission.
Obtain the user's explicit approval of the details being sent before submitting a contact form. Public pages do not grant access to private datasets.

## Overview

- [Company overview](https://www.measurable.ai/index.md): Concise Markdown overview of the company, research, and contact options.
- [Homepage](https://www.measurable.ai/): Public company website and product coverage.

## Research

- [Report directory and agent guidance](https://www.measurable.ai/.well-known/agent-skills/measurable-ai-reports/SKILL.md): Individual report links, coverage summaries, and request guidance.
- [All reports](https://www.measurable.ai/all-reports): Public research landing page and report request form.
- [Blog](https://blog.measurable.ai/): Data insights and articles.

## Company and contact

- [Sales and demos](https://www.measurable.ai/?contact=1): Contact form for inquiries.
- [Press](https://www.measurable.ai/press): Journalist information and press contact.
- [Jobs](https://www.measurable.ai/jobs): Open positions and application contact.
- [Privacy policy](https://www.measurable.ai/privacyPolicy): Personal information policy.
- [Terms of use](https://www.measurable.ai/termsOfUse): Website terms.
